name: cg_coin_categories_list
description:
All coin category names and ids on CoinGecko (coins/categories/list), such as decentralized-finance-defi or meme-token.
Returns {categories: [{category_id, name}, ...]}.
Inputs: none.
For the same categories with market cap, volume and 24h change use cg_coin_categories_market.
Example: {}
No API key is sent (CoinGecko public API, rate-limited by CoinGecko); a failed call returns {"error": ...}.
